sources.title: Interview note containing the mirror-binary-tree question
Deterministic Java mirror-tree validation with structural oracle
Source-first isolated review for the mirror-tree candidate

claims.text: The recovered source explicitly asks for mirror-binary-tree recursive and non-recursive implementations, while mutation/copy semantics, node type and empty-tree API behavior are not preserved.
Recursively mirroring the original right subtree into the new left position and the original left subtree into the new right position satisfies the structural definition of a tree mirror.
An explicit DFS stack can replace recursion: each reachable node is processed once, its left/right references are swapped once, and its non-null children are scheduled for processing.
Both implementations visit each node once for O(n) time and use O(h) traversal state; recursive depth can reach n on a skewed tree, while the iterative variant moves that state to an explicit stack.

The exact Java implementation passes null/single/asymmetric fixed checks, same-root and involution checks, 4000 deterministic randomized trees with both implementations against an independent structural oracle, and a 20000-edge iterative skew-tree check.

checks: known asymmetric tree exact mirror for both variants
4000 deterministic randomized trees checked by both variants against an independent structural oracle

boundary_tests.expected: complete left/right structure is mirrored while values are preserved
original structure and values are restored
iterative implementation mirrors a 20000-edge left chain into a right chain without recursion

findings: The candidate is source-bounded and separates recovered requirements from selected tree/API policies.
Both recursive and non-recursive implementations satisfy the same structural mirror contract and preserve node values.
The independent oracle checks the first mirror result directly rather than relying only on recursive-vs-iterative agreement or involution.
Depth risk is stated explicitly and the iterative fixture includes a 20000-edge skewed tree.
No unsupported project, online-judge or hidden-input claims were introduced.
Formal promotion remains blocked only by the pilot human-approval gate.
